summary: Scienture Holdings filed an 8-K regarding a note purchase agreement with Streeterville Capital for two secured promissory notes totaling $11.42 million principal (A-1 $8.42M, B $3M), with net proceeds of $11M after OID and fees. The A-1 Note bears 9% interest, matures in 18 months, and is prepayable. Maxim Group served as placement agent. The funds will support working capital and commercialization. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
